title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
author: A. Jian Yang, An Huang, Bo Dan, Chen Mu et al.
description: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases…
summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates.
takeaways: We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.
Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates.
The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks.
